output.reason: [ev-61ba1e0463de] says the bug affects deployments served under a custom base path: the history API adds the base path automatically, so the fix strips it from the return URL. The fix changed only UI files [ev-14505230d8c4]. Nothing in the evidence links this to an argocd-server `--server` flag, so the proposed cli-flag leaf names the wrong setting. The evidence also never names the setting that configures the base path, so that part can only be an evidence-gap leaf, combined with the from-version check.

correction.statement: Bug fix: after login, the return_url redirect now works when the Argo CD UI is served under a custom base path. Exposed: environments upgrading from below 3.0.0 that serve the UI under a custom base path. The evidence does not name the setting that configures the base path.

of.needed: which argocd-server setting configures the custom base path for the UI; the release note and PR #21588 only say 'custom server paths' / 'base path' without naming the setting
